result.summary: The page appears visually intact with no critical or major issues. One minor observation regarding the promotional badge on the partially visible card at the bottom.

issues.description: The bottom-most card displays a '-100%' badge, which could be confusing to users as it implies a negative price or an error in discount calculation, rather than a standard 'Free' or '100% off' label.
issues.suggestion: Change the badge text to 'Free delivery' or '100% off' to clearly communicate the promotion without causing confusion.
